name: habrenoir-luxury-mern
description: HABRENOIR Luxury Fashion Catalog & PDP - MERN Stack Architecture

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm.cmd', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'server', stdio: 'inherit' }); spawn('npm.cmd', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'client', stdio: 'inherit' });"
